reviews.comment: Prof Griffith is one of the best professors I have ever had. He made me fall in love with marketing, and ties back every single thing to real world concepts. He is very clear on what is expected, and likes participation in classes. A total pro at marketing strategy, I felt like every class I learned something new, useful, and interesting. Take him!

Professor Griffith is an energetic, enthusiastic, and caring professor that does his best to ensure every student he teaches succeeds. Many times, he's provided great feedback, remained responsive through his emails, and given us great tips on how to succeed in his class. Great professor overall.

Professor Griffith was by far my favorite prof I took in undergrad. The semester group project is tedious but extremely engaging, and Griffith is very helpful throughout the course. He genuinely cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. Can't speak highly enough about him and his class.
David truly cares about his students and their learning and brings an exciting attitude to each lecture. Engages with students and facilitated a great learning environment. Awesome prof.

He is one of, if not THE, nicest prof I have ever had. You can tell that he really enjoys teaching and is very passionate about what he does. The simulation during the second half of the semester is a lot of fun. He is very good about keeping his lectures engaging too. 100% recommend taking his class!

Professor Griffith has been one of my favorite professors this semester! Its obvious he really cares for his students and wants them to learn! The first half of the class is lecture heavy with a weekly assignment then shifts into a group project with a marketing simulation. He does well at keeping the class engaging and fun!
